description: RJ-56 is the District Transport Office (DTO) for Sadulshahar, serving the northernmost part of Rajasthan in the Sri Ganganagar district. This office facilitates vehicle registration, issuing of driving licenses, and other transport-related regulatory services for the local population and farming community.
address: District Transport Office, Hanumangarh Road, Sadulshahar, Rajasthan - 335062
